entities.summary: Carl Aage Hilbert, born in Copenhagen to Doretha Marie and Emil Christopher Hilbert, was the Danish Prefect of the Faroe Islands from 1936 until 1945. During this period, the Faroe Islands had the status of an amt (county) of Denmark.
